title: Punch that misses
situation: She aims at where his head was when she started; he steps aside. The fist goes through empty air, the follow-through drags her a step forward, and she turns back into her guard. The fist is never allowed inside his body. The overbalance before the catching step is declared.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
